headline: A school is only as loved as the people who bring it to life.
retention: At Kidsverse, 99% of our team has stayed with us over the past four years—a story built on trust, care and the relationships we nurture every day.
mission: Now, as we extend that journey into Stone Field International School, we want to build the most loved place to work in our region. We invite thoughtful educators and school professionals to help shape this new chapter.

roles.title: Head of Academics
roles.summary: Lead teaching quality, academic planning and a supportive culture for students and educators.
roles.intro: Help shape the academic experience at Stone Field, supporting teachers and building strong, thoughtful learning practices across the school.
roles.purpose: Lead teachers, teaching quality, curriculum execution, educational content and daily academic operations. This role helps translate the school’s learning vision into dependable classroom practice.
keyAreas: Teacher management: allocate responsibilities, monitor attendance and preparedness, hold regular meetings and follow up on performance concerns.
Academic planning: prepare the academic calendar, timetables, teaching schedules, substitution arrangements and assessment plans.
Teaching quality: observe classes, review lesson plans, give practical feedback and organise teacher development.
Curriculum and content: review worksheets, assessments, learning resources, report cards and classroom content for accuracy and age appropriateness.
Student progress: track learning outcomes, identify gaps and coordinate support with teachers and families.
Daily coordination: help classes, assemblies, activities and transitions run smoothly.
School culture: support consistent expectations for respectful behaviour, classroom routines and professional conduct.
Management reporting: prepare a regular overview of academic progress, teacher support, operational concerns and decisions requiring founder input.
contributions: A clear, caring academic rhythm for the founding school community.
A supported and accountable teaching team with room to improve its practice.
Consistent learning experiences that put student understanding and wellbeing first.

roles.title: Primary Class Teachers — Grades 1, 2 & 3
roles.summary: Build strong foundations and help children grow in confidence, curiosity and independence.
roles.intro: We welcome caring primary educators who can create purposeful, engaging classrooms and support each child’s learning and wellbeing.
roles.purpose: Build strong academic foundations and support each child’s confidence, independence and development through engaging, age-appropriate classroom learning.
keyAreas: Lesson delivery: prepare and teach structured, engaging lessons using practical and activity-based methods.
Foundational learning: develop reading, writing, comprehension, numeracy and communication skills.
Student assessment: maintain baseline assessments, learning records and timely progress reports.
Individual support: identify learning gaps and provide planned reinforcement or enrichment.
Classroom management: establish positive routines and guide behaviour calmly and respectfully.
Content preparation: create accurate lesson plans, worksheets, teaching aids and assessments.
Parent communication: share balanced progress updates and follow through on agreed actions.
Student wellbeing: supervise students, notice concerns and report incidents promptly.
contributions: A safe, inclusive and engaging classroom where children feel known.
Strong early learning habits, confidence and a joy in asking questions.
A thoughtful partnership with families and the wider teaching team.

roles.title: Parent & Student Relations Counsellor
roles.summary: Help families and students feel heard, supported and connected to the school community.
roles.intro: Be a thoughtful point of contact for parent concerns and student adjustment, helping questions move towards clear and caring follow-through.
roles.reportsTo: Founders / Management; works closely with the Head of Academics and teachers
roles.purpose: Support parent concerns, student adjustment and family experience through careful listening, clear communication and reliable follow-up.
keyAreas: Concern resolution: record concerns, agree next actions, track responsibility and communicate closure.
Response standards: acknowledge enquiries promptly and keep families updated within agreed timelines.
Parent feedback: collect structured feedback and report recurring themes and improvement actions.
Student support: help children with school adjustment, friendships, attendance and everyday school concerns.
Parent partnership: coordinate meetings and help families understand school processes and student needs.
Escalation: bring serious or unresolved concerns directly to management.
Confidential records: maintain factual records with appropriate access controls.
Management insights: share regular patterns in concern types, resolution times and family feedback.
contributions: A warm, dependable connection between families and the school.
Clear follow-through that helps concerns reach the right person and next step.
Thoughtful feedback that helps the school improve its family experience.

roles.title: School Driver
roles.summary: Help children travel safely and reliably to and from school.
roles.intro: We are looking for careful, dependable drivers who put student safety, punctuality and courteous conduct first.
roles.purpose: Transport students safely, reliably and courteously, following school procedures throughout each journey.
requirements: Minimum 2 years of experience driving a school bus.
keyAreas: Safe driving: follow road rules, approved routes, speed limits and safe stopping practices.
Vehicle readiness: complete daily checks and report maintenance needs before operating an unsafe vehicle.
Punctuality: maintain dependable pickup and drop schedules without compromising safety.
Authorised handover: coordinate with attendants so children are released through the approved process.
Transport records: maintain trip, mileage, fuel, inspection and incident records.
Emergency response: follow breakdown, accident and emergency communication procedures.
Professional conduct: treat children and families respectfully and never use a phone while driving.
contributions: A safe and reassuring journey for students and families.
Dependable care of the school vehicle and transport routines.

roles.title: School Bus Attendant / Conductor
roles.summary: Support children throughout their journey with attentive supervision and care.
roles.intro: Help make every school journey safe and reassuring, from boarding and travel through to an authorised handover.
roles.purpose: Supervise children throughout the journey and support safe boarding, travel and handover to authorised adults.
keyAreas: Student accountability: check student lists during boarding and drop-off.
Safe boarding: assist children at stops and supervise entry and exit.
Journey supervision: help children remain safely seated and guide behaviour respectfully.
Child support: respond to illness or distress and alert the school promptly.
Authorised handover: verify the receiving adult according to school instructions.
Final vehicle check: inspect the entire vehicle after each trip so no child or belongings remain.
Incident reporting: promptly record delays, injuries, behaviour concerns and handover issues.
contributions: Calm, attentive supervision that helps children feel safe while travelling.
Reliable communication with the driver, families and school team.

roles.title: School Support Staff / Classroom Attendant
roles.summary: Help classrooms and student routines run smoothly, safely and warmly.
roles.intro: Work alongside teachers to prepare learning spaces and support children through the everyday rhythms of school.
roles.reportsTo: Designated Operations In-charge; classroom work coordinated by teachers
roles.purpose: Support children’s daily routines and help classrooms operate smoothly, while preserving each child’s safety and dignity.
keyAreas: Child assistance: help younger students with belongings, meals, hygiene and toilet routines respectfully.
Classroom readiness: arrange materials and prepare spaces for lessons and activities.
Safe movement: assist with supervised transitions, dispersal and school events.
Teacher support: help with practical classroom arrangements under teacher direction.
Hygiene: follow handwashing, cleaning and illness-reporting procedures.
Concern reporting: promptly report injuries, distress, hazards or unusual incidents.
contributions: A welcoming, prepared classroom environment.
Patient support for children as they learn school routines and independence.

roles.title: Housekeeping & Cleaning Staff
roles.summary: Help maintain clean, hygienic and welcoming spaces across the campus.
roles.intro: We welcome dependable team members who take pride in maintaining a clean and safe environment for children, families and colleagues.
roles.purpose: Maintain a clean, hygienic and safe campus for students, families and staff throughout the school day.
keyAreas: Scheduled cleaning: complete checklists for classrooms, corridors, offices and activity areas.
Washroom hygiene: inspect and clean washrooms regularly and replenish essential supplies.
Safe storage: secure cleaning chemicals and equipment away from children.
Waste management: collect, segregate and dispose of waste appropriately.
Hazard prevention: address spills promptly and use warning signs for wet floors.
Issue reporting: report leaks, damaged fittings, pests and maintenance needs.
Event readiness: prepare and restore spaces before and after school activities.
contributions: Clean and welcoming spaces for the whole school community.
Careful routines that protect children’s health and safety.

roles.title: Physical Education, Fitness & School Discipline Instructor
roles.summary: Build fitness, coordination, sportsmanship and positive school routines.
roles.intro: Lead age-appropriate movement and sports experiences that help children grow stronger, work together and practise positive routines.
roles.purpose: Develop fitness, coordination, sportsmanship and positive school routines through safe, encouraging and age-appropriate activities.
keyAreas: Age-appropriate fitness: plan enjoyable sessions that build balance, agility, coordination, stamina and flexibility.
Sports foundations: teach basic games, movement skills, teamwork and fair play.
Progress tracking: monitor improvement without public comparisons or embarrassment.
School routines: support orderly assemblies, transitions, punctuality and respectful behaviour.
Positive discipline: build self-control through encouragement; no physical punishment or punitive exercise.
Activity safety: inspect equipment, adapt activities to children’s needs and follow injury procedures.
Events: coordinate sports days, fitness activities and suitable inter-house events.
Staff coordination: work with teachers on movement breaks and healthy daily habits.
contributions: A joyful and safe approach to movement and physical confidence.
Positive routines that support teamwork, wellbeing and self-discipline.

roles.title: Dance Teacher
roles.summary: Encourage expression, rhythm and confidence through dance and movement.
roles.intro: We welcome dance practitioners who can share their craft and create inclusive, age-appropriate opportunities for children to move and express themselves.
roles.purpose: Build confidence, expression, rhythm and coordination through dance and creative movement.
requirements: Applicants should demonstrate strong ability in dance.
keyAreas: Lesson planning: deliver age-appropriate dance and creative movement sessions.
Skill development: build rhythm, posture, coordination, expression and group participation.
Inclusive participation: involve beginners and less-confident children, not only experienced performers.
Performances: prepare students for assemblies and events within agreed rehearsal schedules.
Safety: use suitable warm-ups, movements, music and physical expectations.
Progress records: track participation and care for costumes or props assigned to the role.
contributions: An inclusive space for children to explore movement and self-expression.
Creative performances that celebrate participation and practice.

roles.title: Music Teacher
roles.summary: Help children discover rhythm, listening and the joy of making music.
roles.intro: We welcome music practitioners who can share their craft and help children explore music in an encouraging, engaging environment.
roles.purpose: Develop musical awareness, listening, expression and performance confidence through shared music-making.
requirements: Applicants should demonstrate strong ability in music.
keyAreas: Music foundations: teach rhythm, pitch, listening, singing and introductory instruments.
Lesson planning: prepare structured activities appropriate for primary-age children.
Participation: give every child opportunities to explore music and perform.
School programmes: prepare songs and musical presentations for assemblies and events.
Instrument care: maintain equipment and teach children safe handling.
Progress tracking: record participation, skills developed and areas for encouragement.
contributions: A welcoming introduction to music for children with different experience levels.
Creative opportunities for listening, practice and performance.
